# Menu props

## Menu.Content Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `sideOffset` | `number \| OffsetFunction \| undefined` | `8` | Distance from the trigger element in pixels; as on Popover, wide enough for the focus ring. |
| `side` | `"top" \| "bottom" \| "left" \| "right"` | — | Preferred side of the trigger to render against. |
| `align` | `"start" \| "center" \| "end"` | — | Alignment along the chosen side. |
| `alignOffset` | `number \| OffsetFunction \| undefined` | `0` | Offset from the alignment edge in pixels. |
| `arrowPadding` | `number \| undefined` | `corner radius + 0.21 × arrow size (≈ 10.07)` | How close the arrow may come to the popup's ends, in pixels. The default, read when the popup mounts and when its arrow mounts or unmounts, keeps the arrow's foot off the popup's rounded corner at any `--radius` and `--spacing`. |
